_note: Temporary-duty daily allowance table, transcribed from an owner-supplied phone image of a rates sheet on 2026-10-11 (the TD block only). NOT wired to figures.json or the bundle: the sheet shows no letter number, issuer or date, so it is evidence of the numbers, not an authority. Every value equals the handbook base x 1.25 (the da_step rule at DA 50-99%), which is why it is kept as a cross-check for plan 21 (F4, F6) and not as a second source of truth.

source.document: Unattributed rates sheet (image), block 'Daily Allce on TD'
source.issuer: unknown compiler; shared on social media (owner, 2026-10-11)
source.dated: after DA passed 50% (owner); exact date unknown
source.evidence_detail: Image read line by line. A third party compiled it after DA passed 50% and it circulated on social media; it carries no order number, issuer or date, and the primary text was not read. Its HRA line (27/18/9) is one DA step behind the approved figure (30/20/10 at DA 50%), so the compiler got at least one line wrong and the sheet is not trusted on its own.

approved_note: Do not approve from this sheet. Approve when the primary MoD letter that applies the 25% step to the TD lump sums is found and its effective date is pinned (plan 21, F6). P1 update (2026-10-11): the figures were matched line by line against UT Ladakh Finance Dept Order 231-F of 2024 (civil, w.e.f. 01.01.2024); see 23_ta_da_preclaim_rate_register.md. The sheet is still not an approval source.

bands.taxi: AC taxi at actual expenditure, commensurate with official engagements, within the city

cross_check.base_source: Handbook on Travelling Allowances 2023, 'Rates of Daily Allowance as per 7th CPC w.e.f. 01 July 2017'
cross_check.rule: lump sum rises 25% whenever DA rises by 50% (MoD letter 12630/Mov C/242/D(Mov)/2017, para 2(iv); figures.json da_step)

not_transcribed: Rows for pay levels 5A to 8 and 5 and below (JCO/OR), and the sheet's other blocks (tele claim, briefcase, newspaper, hospitality, CEA, hostel subsidy, dress allowance, HRA, baggage on permanent move). Not in scope for the officer pre-claim; the baggage block (62.50 per km) agrees with plan F2.
conflict_noted: The sheet's 'Road Mileage (RMA): Rs 30/-' disagrees with Wing Circular 10 (rma_rates.json: Rs 12 to 30 by state). The dated, state-wise circular wins; Rs 30 is only its top rate.
